cells.why: The docs site documents a read-only MCP connector with its setup command.
A public OpenAPI 3.0.3 file downloads from the API host; the probe fetched it.
The public API reference covers read-only endpoints; nothing writes.
Only a starting price ('From $500/Month'); the page body is a quote form.
An API is offered to companies but is scoped per integration, with no public reference.
The API page says it is an example, not an API specification.
No MCP server is mentioned; the pack shows only a ChatGPT entry point.
No prices anywhere; the pricing address is a 404 and plans lead to a demo.
Product pages say API access exists, with no public reference.
The plans page shows no prices and asks visitors to contact the company.
An MCP server is described for Enterprise clients, but the pack shows no setup steps.
Sandbox environments are listed only as an Enterprise plan feature.
The llms.txt file lists site pages and blog posts, not documentation.
A documented hosted MCP server with 40 tools, OAuth and scopes.
Read and write scopes are granted separately and listed by resource.
No pricing page (404) and no prices shown.
Microsoft Graph documents REST create, read, update and delete on Excel workbooks.
Graph permissions are documented scopes, with read-only and read-write variants.
Every call to action is Get a Demo or Log In.
The vendor says it has REST APIs and a two-way open API, with no public documentation.
